If you find any problems with the extension, the documentation, or anything else, please report them. :folded_hands::folded_hands:  
You can report issues by either replying to this forum post, or by opening issues on the LLMAI JIRA.

Root cause: XWiki MCP extension uses Dynamic Client Registration (DCR). It generates a throwaway client\_id (eqxQI3b…) and sends it to IAS — but IAS doesn’t support DCR, so it  
rejects the auth request → 401.

[...] ## Explore what the MCP Server can do with your knowledge

Use the XWiki MCP Server in XWiki Cloud, on your self-hosted instance, or not at all. Connecting AI to your wiki should always be your choice. Everything we've built was built with these principles in mind.

Even in beta, the current version of the XWiki MCP Server extension can already do a lot. You can work with pages, structured data, and attachments, all in natural language, and while using your preferred AI tools.

If you're looking into adding AI to your wiki, we hope you'll try out the new XWiki MCP Server. If you run into any issues, let us know! We'll get it sorted out as quickly as humanly possible.

## How to connect an AI assistant to your wiki

The prerequisites are:

 MCP Server (BETA) extension installed
 OpenID Connect Provider extension installed
 MCP Authentication set up

Configuration page for the XWiki MCP Server

The next steps depend on which AI tool you want to use to connect to the XWiki MCP Server. You can find a list pointing to MCP-related documentation pages for multiple tools on the Assistant documentation links page.
